disambiguation: Not a markdown editor; it displays rich metadata previews in the rendered view without modifying the source.
extras: Custom preview colors can be set using an Obsidian CSS snippet.
problem: Standard Markdown links lack visual context, making it difficult to quickly assess the content of a URL within a note.
summary: Link preview plugin that automatically fetches and displays rich metadata (title, description, favicon) for URLs in Obsidian without altering the original Markdown source.
